🚨| 𝐁𝐑𝐄𝐀𝐊𝐈𝐍𝐆: A HEATED confrontation reportedly took place inside Barcelona's boardroom during the Atlético Madrid match.

Before kick-off, Mateu Alemany approached several Barça board members with whom he had previously worked and greeted them. At half-time, Alejandro Echevarría confronted those directors for greeting Alemany, given the strained relationship between him and the club. Several board members objected, explaining that Alemany had simply approached them to say hello. Enric Masip stepped in to defend the directors, insisting that it was nothing more than a simple greeting. The argument continued to escalate until Joan Laporta had to raise his voice to put an end to it.

Some board members are reportedly still deeply resentful towards Echevarría over the way he has treated them repeatedly. [@esport3] #fcblive 💥

🚨🗣️ Xavier Bosch (@mundodeportivo): “Deco and the club’s plan for the summer was to keep Ronald Araújo, sign Alessandro Bastoni on a five-year agreement that was already in place, and move on from Andreas Christensen.

However, Flick preferred to continue relying on Gerard Martín, renew Christensen’s contract and avoid signing a new CB, opting instead to strengthen the attacking options. The club ultimately backed Flick’s vision.

So, if Bastoni wasn’t convincing enough for Flick in the summer, what makes people think he would convince him in January? Flick clearly sees him as too slow for a high defensive line, and he certainly won’t suddenly become Usain Bolt in January.” #fcblive
